name: Pension Schmied im Tal
beschreibung:
History

A website of the Pension Schmied im Tal was not found. Firmania lists at the address Schmiedtal 15, 6335 Thiersee, the Gasthaus Schmiedtal with the telephone number +43 5376 5514. PocketAustria names a guesthouse Pension Schmied im Tal, Schmiedtal 15, and the postcode 6330 instead of 6335. cartes.app names 15 Schmiedtal, 6335 Thiersee, the same telephone number and the coordinates 47.59507, 12.07252. Whether the pension and the inn are the same business is suggested by the directories through the shared address and telephone number, but they do not say so expressly. A year of construction, names of innkeepers or a menu are missing. Older texts about solid home-style cooking, traditional charm or a quiet stay away from the bustle are therefore not documented.

Getting there

The address that matches on the more detailed directories is Schmiedtal 15, 6335 Thiersee. A stop, a timetable or a parking note is not stated there. Telephone +43 5376 5514.

Tips

Rooms, prices, board and opening hours are not publicly documented. Before arrival it should be clarified on the number named whether guest rooms are offered at all or only an inn business. The postcode deviation 6330 on PocketAustria should not be read as a second address.
